description: Everything public RoTerminal has on up to 4 games, 3 studios and 3 people, already worked out, in one call. A game: players now, its place on Roblox, its 1-hour and 24-hour change, this week’s average against the week before, highs (24 hours, 14 days, since tracking began on Sep 27 2026), our Robux estimate and its Top Earning place, its genre and place in it, its developer, studio, owner and the people behind it, its latest updates (with how players moved after each) and events, its places on Roblox’s charts, similar games, visits, favorites, likes and minutes a visit, its store and its page. A studio: who runs it, its numbers, games, people and groups. A person: what kind they are, their studio, groups, own games and posts. A name whose kind you don’t know goes in `name`.

context.description: For people: the game or studio the question puts them at (optional)

games.description: Games: names, universe ids or links (up to 4)

items.description: The game: its name (like "grow a garden"), its universe id, its Roblox link or place id, or its roterminal.co/g/ link

studios.description: Studios or Roblox groups: names, keys from find (p…, g…, u…) or links (up to 3)

name: dossier
title: Everything at once
